data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Dashboard with Live Metrics
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for various metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays real-time data.
Includes line, bar, and area charts for different metrics.
Charts update dynamically with new data.

features.title: Chart.js Integration for Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize data such as pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Chart.js is used for all visualizations.
Visualizations include pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
Charts are interactive and animated.

features.title: 8-Stage Pipeline Visualization
acceptance_criteria: The pipeline is displayed as a Chart.js visualization.
Each stage is clearly labeled and distinct.
Visualization is interactive and informative.

features.title: Results Section with Real Metrics
features.description: Present real metrics from recent runs in the results section.
acceptance_criteria: Results section includes actual data from recent runs.
Data is presented in a clear and understandable format.
Charts and visuals support the data presentation.

features.title: Code Quality Visualization
features.description: Show TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance and SOLID principles.
Data is accurate and reflects current practices.
Chart is visually clear and informative.

features.title: HTML Presentation Creation
features.description: Develop a standalone HTML file for the Artemis self-demo with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: The HTML file is standalone with all resources embedded.
CSS and JavaScript are included within the HTML file.
Chart.js library is embedded and functional.

features.title: Feature Metrics Visualization
features.description: Showcase cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning metrics with Chart.js.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are displayed using Chart.js.
Charts for cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning are included.
Data is accurate and up-to-date.

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Illustrate supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: A pie chart shows supervisor integration across stages.
Data is clearly represented and easy to understand.
Chart is interactive and visually appealing.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can navigate back and forth between slides.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: HERO Section: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO section introducing Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: The HERO section clearly introduces Artemis.
Information is concise and engaging.
Visuals support the introduction effectively.

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional gradient background and smooth transitions between slides.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied to all slides.
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional.
Design is consistent with a professional presentation.
